$comment: The executable spec's gate list. SPEC §5:
DONE(F) = Pure ∧ Reachable ∧ Contract ∧ Executable ∧ Environment ∧ Regression
Each gate reports one of GREEN / RED / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_RUN (SPEC §4-5).
INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_RUN block DONE — they are not soft passes.
`monitorable: false` marks a term that cannot be decided from a finite local
trace. Such a term can never be GREEN here; the honest value is INCONCLUSIVE.
A binary GREEN/RED gate would silently turn it into a false GREEN, which is
the failure SPEC §4-5 exists to prevent.
